blocks.text: Some Singhs wished to rule in Punjab itself, while the Guru told them to ask for vast dominion — to the south, the hills, the east, and the west. (15)
But the Singhs replied that if each asked for Punjab separately they would only end up quarrelling among themselves. (16)
The Guru then urged them to seek broad jagirs and authority, while they answered that each desired only the country nearest his own home. (17–18)
